# Pitex 1.0.3

This release reduces PDF conversion time in embedded editing preview on macOS
and Ubuntu, especially with large TeX Live font maps.

## Changes

- Index font-map entries during PDF conversion instead of comparing each line
  against every preceding entry. Preserve duplicate warnings, replacements,
  removals and fresh font-map state for each preview generation.
- Keep the 16 ms edit coalescing window introduced in 1.0.2.

A repeated-edit Linux benchmark with a two-page math document and a 45,497-line
font map reduced median engine update time from 2.30 seconds to 56 ms. This is a
Linux engine measurement; macOS performance depends on the document and TeX
installation. macOS engine, application and native editor checks passed.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 through 1.0.2 update to 1.0.3 from Settings or, with automatic
installation enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run `brew update`
and `brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.0.3 from
the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
